start.card:
You are on a Ferris wheel. The spoke from the middle (the axle) to your seat is 20 m long.
You start level with the axle. The wheel turns 60° (a bit more than half way to the top). How high above the axle are you? Make a guess first.
start.title: Ferris wheel heights

afterGuess.card:
Good. Now turn the wheel and measure.
Press "Turn to 30°" and read your height.
afterGuess.title: Ferris wheel heights

after.card:
At 90° you are at the top, 20 m up, and height ÷ spoke is 1.
Takeaway: height ÷ spoke is the sine. It rises fast at first, then slows near the top, so sin 30° = 0.5 but sin 60° is only about 0.87.
after.title: Ferris wheel heights
